research_target: A recurrent picture state that carries event history through the frozen VLM image interface.
diagnostic_question: Does R5 fail because every event restarts DreamLite from pure noise and redraws the complete state?

fixed_contract.dataset: formal-v1 train/dev with the R5 deterministic split
fixed_contract.train_subset: two deterministic segments from each of F2/F3/F5/F6; the same hard8 batch is repeated
fixed_contract.updater: DreamLite-mobile U-Net LoRA rank 4; base frozen
fixed_contract.learning_rate_schedule: R5 640-step schedule prefix: 16-step 1e-5 to 3e-5 warmup then cosine toward 1e-5

paired_diagnostics: hard8 train endpoint versus arm-specific M0
fixed formal-select-32 endpoint versus arm-specific M0
fixed mechanism-select-32 endpoint versus arm-specific M0
normal/reset difference-in-differences from M0 to endpoint
cross-episode and temporal state swaps on hard8
per-segment full-gradient norm and pairwise gradient cosine

interpretation_rules.source_anchor_pass_legacy_fail: pure-noise redraw is a supported primary cause; advance sigma=0.5 to a fixed full-data pilot
interpretation_rules.both_pass: recurrence can overfit under both laws; compare fixed-dev generalization and gradient conflict before selecting
interpretation_rules.both_fail: reject start sigma as sufficient; next test per-micro gradient conflict/balancing without increasing rank or data
interpretation_rules.legacy_pass_source_anchor_fail: source anchoring is rejected and must not advance

formal_success_still_requires: normal better than reset and state swaps
endpoint improvement over its own M0 with paired uncertainty
